subject: SparkLoop pilot credit onboarding & usage plan
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi@sparkloop.ai>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Paul Nguyen <paul@sparkloop.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pilot credits & onboarding next steps

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at SparkLoop is excited to proceed with a short pilot to validate recommendation workflows and embeddings for our campaign analytics. Before we kick off, two asks:

1) Can Redwood approve an initial pilot credit allocation and a one-month trial extension beyond our free tier so we can run the integration across two customer cohorts?
2) Can you share the onboarding checklist and any security questionnaire items we should expect? We need those for our procurement review.

Attached is a short one-pager about the pilot scope and some projected token usage. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that helps.

Thanks,
Aditi Rao
Head of Product, SparkLoop
aditi@sparkloop.ai

Attachments: SparkLoop_Onboarding_Details.pdf (pdf, 0.2MB)
From: maya_srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Rao <aditi@sparkloop.ai>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jun 2028 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & onboarding next steps

Hi Aditi — great to hear, and thanks for the doc.

Short answers up front: we can offer a pilot credit package (see details below) and a 30-day trial extension on top of the standard free tier. To get that approved quickly I just need:
- an estimated token usage by week (you provided a high-level number; can you confirm weekly peak?)
- confirmation of the legal contact for the SOW (we have a short SOW to attach for signature)
- any additional compliance artifacts you need beyond our SOC 2 and data-retention overview

Proposed credit allocation (subject to final sign-off by Ops):
- 250k token credit for the first 30 days
- optional +100k token top-up if usage exceeds the forecasted threshold (manual request)

Next steps:
1) If you can confirm the weekly peak and legal contact today, I’ll route the credit request to our Commercial Ops and loop in Finance for the SOW.
2) Dev will handle environment setup and integration details — I’ve cc’d him.
3) We’ll share the onboarding checklist and a short SSO/KMS integration doc (links) once Ops confirms.

Availability: I can do a quick 20-min alignment call tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Phone: (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: Request: pilot credits & onboarding next steps

Hi Aditi — looping in the technical side so we can get a concrete estimate for the credit drawdown and environment prep. A few quick items from engineering: 

- For embeddings and nightly batch scoring across two cohorts we expect roughly 60–90k tokens/day depending on cadence. If you plan multiple reruns, please indicate rerun cadence.
- We can provision a dedicated sandbox project with API keys scoped to the pilot; that will isolate usage and make billing simple.
- For SSO we support SAML and OIDC; if you want KMS/HSM integration for key material, we’ll need an internal ticket and lead time (~2 weeks).

Suggested execution:
1) Approve the 250k token credit. That should cover initial integration + two weeks of cohort testing at typical cadence.
2) We’ll provision the sandbox and share an integration guide (Postman / SDK examples).
3) Send over the legal contact for SOW; finance will create a short SOW (no charge for the pilot credits, standard terms apply).

If you’re available today at 3pm PT, I can run through provisioning steps with your engineering manager.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Thanks, Maya / Dev — this all looks great. Quick answers:

- Weekly peak (expected): ~120k tokens during cohort rollouts; average daily ~70k. We won’t be doing overnight reruns in the first 2 weeks.
- Legal contact: Maria Ortega (maria.ortega@sparkloop.ai) — please send SOW to her for signature.
- Compliance: SOC 2 and data-retention overview should be sufficient for our procurement; if we need anything else I’ll escalate.

We accept the proposed 250k pilot credit and will request the +100k top-up if we hit the threshold. Can we get the sandbox provisioned and the SOW this week? Also happy to take the 3pm PT sync if you’re available.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Aditi
